name: Sukhoi Su 57 Felon Fighter Jet Free
operating_principle: The Sukhoi Su-57 Felon is a twin-engine stealth multirole fighter aircraft that uses thrust vectoring nozzles and advanced flight control systems to achieve high maneuverability and departure resistance. It is designed with stealth technology to reduce its radar cross-section.
